import pandas as pd, numpy as np, time
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
counts=pd.read_csv('inputs/counts_raw_unfiltered.csv',index_col=0).T
meta=pd.read_csv('inputs/sample_layout.csv')
meta['key']=meta.SampleID.str.replace('-','_',regex=False)
meta=meta.set_index('key').loc[counts.index]
meta=meta.rename(columns={'Group':'condition'})[['condition']]
print('all-zero rows',int((counts.sum()==0).sum()),'modeled',int((counts.sum()>0).sum()),flush=True)
t=time.time()
dds=DeseqDataSet(counts=counts,metadata=meta,design='~condition',refit_cooks=True,n_cpus=4,quiet=True)
dds.deseq2()
print('fit seconds',round(time.time()-t,1),flush=True)
for name,target,control in [('standard','CBD_IC50','DMSO'),('starved','CBD_IC50_Serum_starvation_16h','DMSO_Serum_starvation')]:
 ds=DeseqStats(dds,contrast=['condition',target,control],alpha=.05,independent_filter=True,cooks_filter=True,n_cpus=4,quiet=True)
 ds.summary()
 z=ds.results_df
 sig=z[(z.padj<.05)&(z.log2FoldChange.abs()>.5)]
 print(name,'tested padj',z.padj.notna().sum(),'sig',len(sig),'up',sum(sig.log2FoldChange>.5),'down',sum(sig.log2FoldChange<-.5),flush=True)
 print('lfc summary',sig.log2FoldChange.describe().to_dict(),flush=True)
 # save only in process? serialize for next enrichment prohibited evidence files. We'll rerun or create tmp then delete.
 z[['baseMean','log2FoldChange','pvalue','padj']].to_csv(f'/workspace/tmp_{name}_de.csv')
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd,numpy as np,sqlite3
from scipy.stats import hypergeom
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
counts=pd.read_csv('inputs/counts_raw_unfiltered.csv',index_col=0)
org=sqlite3.connect('.go_tmp/org.sqlite'); go=sqlite3.connect('.go_tmp/go.sqlite')
ensmap=pd.read_sql_query('select distinct e.ensembl_id, g.gene_id from ensembl e join genes g on e._id=g._id',org)
gomap=pd.read_sql_query('select distinct g.gene_id, b.go_id from go_bp_all b join genes g on b._id=g._id',org)
terms=pd.read_sql_query(\"select go_id,term from go_term where ontology='BP'\",go)
term_name=dict(zip(terms.go_id,terms.term))
rootid=go.execute(\"select _id from go_term where go_id='GO:0008152'\").fetchone()[0]
metabolic={r[0] for r in go.execute('select t.go_id from go_bp_offspring x join go_term t on x._offspring_id=t._id where x._id=?',(rootid,))}
metabolic.add('GO:0008152')
# Universe all nonzero count rows mapped to Entrez, same mapping policy as foreground
modeled=set(counts.index[counts.sum(axis=1)>0])
map_by_ens=ensmap.groupby('ensembl_id').gene_id.apply(set).to_dict()
def mapgenes(gs): return set().union(*(map_by_ens.get(x,set()) for x in gs)) if gs else set()
univ=mapgenes(modeled)
gomap=gomap[gomap.gene_id.isin(univ)]
sets=gomap.groupby('go_id').gene_id.apply(set).to_dict()
sets={goid:s for goid,s in sets.items() if 10<=len(s)<=500}
print('modeled ensembl',len(modeled),'mapped universe Entrez',len(univ),'GO BP sets tested',len(sets),'metabolic ontology terms total',len(metabolic))
def ora(fg):
 fg=fg & univ; N=len(univ); n=len(fg); rows=[]
 for goid,s in sets.items():
  k=len(fg&s)
  if k:
   rows.append((goid,term_name.get(goid,''),k,len(s),hypergeom.sf(k-1,N,len(s),n)))
 z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['go_id','term','hits','setsize','p'])
 z['padj']=multipletests(z.p,method='fdr_bh')[1]
 z['fold_enrich']=(z.hits/n)/(z.setsize/N)
 z['metabolic']=z.go_id.isin(metabolic)
 return z.sort_values(['padj','p','go_id'])
for contrast in ['standard','starved']:
 de=pd.read_csv(f'tmp_{contrast}_de.csv',index_col=0)
 sig=de[(de.padj<.05)&(de.log2FoldChange.abs()>.5)]
 print('\\n###',contrast)
 for direction,ids in [('up',set(sig.index[sig.log2FoldChange>.5])),('down',set(sig.index[sig.log2FoldChange<-.5]))]:
  fg=mapgenes(ids); z=ora(fg); zs=z[z.padj<.05]; zm=zs[zs.metabolic]
  print(direction,'DE_ens',len(ids),'FG_entrez',len(fg&univ),'sig_GO',len(zs),'sig_metabolic_desc',len(zm),'median_metabolic_padj',zm.padj.median() if len(zm) else None)
  print('TOP ALL')
  print(z.head(15)[['go_id','term','hits','setsize','padj','fold_enrich','metabolic']].to_string(index=False))
  print('TOP SIG METABOLIC')
  print(zm.head(25)[['go_id','term','hits','setsize','padj','fold_enrich']].to_string(index=False))
PY"

import pandas as pd,time
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
allc=pd.read_csv('inputs/counts_raw_unfiltered.csv',index_col=0)
m=pd.read_csv('inputs/sample_layout.csv'); m['key']=m.SampleID.str.replace('-','_',regex=False); m=m.set_index('key')
keep=(allc.ge(5).sum(axis=1)>=3)
sel=m.index[m.Group.isin(['CBD_IC50','DMSO'])]
c=allc.loc[keep,sel].T
meta=m.loc[sel].rename(columns={'Group':'condition'})[['condition']]
print('prefilter retained',keep.sum(),'pair samples',list(sel),flush=True)
t=time.time(); dds=DeseqDataSet(counts=c,metadata=meta,design='~condition',refit_cooks=True,n_cpus=4,quiet=True); dds.deseq2(); print('fit seconds',round(time.time()-t,1),flush=True)
ds=DeseqStats(dds,contrast=['condition','CBD_IC50','DMSO'],alpha=.1,independent_filter=True,cooks_filter=True,n_cpus=4,quiet=True); ds.summary(); z=ds.results_df
sig=z[(z.padj<.05)&(z.log2FoldChange.abs()>.5)]
print('padj nonNA',z.padj.notna().sum(),'sig',len(sig),'up',sum(sig.log2FoldChange>.5),'down',sum(sig.log2FoldChange<-.5),flush=True)
print(z.loc[z.index.intersection(['ENSG00000167772','ENSG00000165029','ENSG00000114268','ENSG00000125740','ENSG00000140465','ENSG00000138061']),['log2FoldChange','pvalue','padj']].to_string(),flush=True)
z[['baseMean','log2FoldChange','pvalue','padj']].to_csv('/workspace/tmp_pairwise_de.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,sqlite3
from scipy.stats import hypergeom
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
counts=pd.read_csv('inputs/counts_raw_unfiltered.csv',index_col=0); de=pd.read_csv('tmp_pairwise_de.csv',index_col=0)
org=sqlite3.connect('.go_tmp/org.sqlite'); godb=sqlite3.connect('.go_tmp/go.sqlite')
ens=pd.read_sql_query('select distinct e.ensembl_id,g.gene_id from ensembl e join genes g on e._id=g._id',org)
bp=pd.read_sql_query('select distinct g.gene_id,b.go_id from go_bp_all b join genes g on b._id=g._id',org)
term=dict(godb.execute(\"select go_id,term from go_term where ontology='BP'\").fetchall())
root=godb.execute(\"select _id from go_term where go_id='GO:0008152'\").fetchone()[0]
met={x[0] for x in godb.execute('select t.go_id from go_bp_offspring o join go_term t on o._offspring_id=t._id where o._id=?',(root,))}|{'GO:0008152'}
mp=ens.groupby('ensembl_id').gene_id.apply(set).to_dict()
def mapped(ids):
 out=set()
 for x in ids: out.update(mp.get(x,set()))
 return out
univ=mapped(set(de.index)); bp=bp[bp.gene_id.isin(univ)]; gs=bp.groupby('go_id').gene_id.apply(set).to_dict(); gs={k:v for k,v in gs.items() if 10<=len(v)<=500}
def ora(ids):
 fg=mapped(set(ids))&univ; rows=[]
 for go,s in gs.items():
  k=len(fg&s)
  if k: rows.append([go,term.get(go,''),k,len(s),hypergeom.sf(k-1,len(univ),len(s),len(fg))])
 z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['GO','term','hits','size','p']);z['padj']=multipletests(z.p,method='fdr_bh')[1];z['FE']=(z.hits/len(fg))/(z['size']/len(univ));z['met']=z.GO.isin(met)
 return fg,z.sort_values(['padj','p','GO'])
sig=de[(de.padj<.05)&(de.log2FoldChange.abs()>.5)]
print('universe',len(univ),'DE',len(sig))
for direction,ids in [('up',sig.index[sig.log2FoldChange>.5]),('down',sig.index[sig.log2FoldChange<-.5])]:
 fg,z=ora(ids);zs=z[z.padj<.05];zm=zs[zs.met]
 print('\\n',direction,'fg',len(fg),'sigGO',len(zs),'sig metabolic descendants',len(zm))
 print('top all\\n',z.head(25)[['GO','term','hits','size','padj','FE','met']].to_string(index=False))
 print('sig metabolic\\n',zm.head(40)[['GO','term','hits','size','padj','FE']].to_string(index=False))
